description: Portable harness profile: the ai-orchestra kit is the single engine authority. Every host-specific path, credential-backed feature and optional capability is declared here; nothing in harness/kit hardcodes one. An entry resolved to null is a feature this host does not have, and the engine must report it unavailable rather than guess a path.

engine.verbSurface: help, ask, consult, plan, start, status, resume, stop, salvage, selftest, engines, updates, nanny, reset, harvest, vision-smoke, watch, supervise, quality

runtime.windowsNote: Runs under WSL2 bash + Node 22. Native Windows cmd/PowerShell is not a supported shell for the launcher.

state.note: The engine resolves its own state root as <kit home>/runs and creates it on first run. ORCH_STATE_DIR names a different harness lane's state root and is only validated: it must resolve outside the engine home so a portable-harness run id can never overlap it. The shipped tree carries no runs/ directory.

mapping.note: Explicit container<->host table. `container` is the path the engine sees; `host` is what an external tool (ssh, docker cp, an editor) needs. hostEnv overrides hostDefault; when both are absent the entry is UNMAPPED and translation is identity.

table.role: engine home as mounted for a containerised host; used only for consult pointer host paths
worker workspace root; used for free-seat path translation and consult attach normalisation
documentation tree for the memory-impact staleness walk; unmapped = no impact walk, never a failure

repoql.note: RepoQL is an external retrieval engine and is not bundled. Set `bin` (or REPOQL_BIN) and `cwd` (or REPOQL_CWD) to a working rql host; until then retrieval-dependent stages degrade to INSUFFICIENT and the selftest probe reports UNAVAILABLE.

openchamberWatch.note: Live OpenChamber/HA narration is a fleet-observability feature, not engine behaviour. All four values must be set for the watch cycle to run; otherwise it reports unavailable and produces no events.

consultFetch.note: Optional read-only SSH host used to fetch an --open file that is not present locally; CONSULT_FETCH_HOST overrides it. null = no remote fetch at all: the consultant brief reports the file as unreadable rather than guessing a host.

hubDocs.note: Overrides the hubDocs mapping entry when a host keeps docs somewhere else.

rustAuthority.note: The Rust state authority ships dormant and opt-in. It is never built, started or selected by the launcher; the JavaScript engine remains the run-state authority. Enabling it requires an operator decision plus AF_UNIX support (WSL2/Linux only) and an MSVC toolchain on Windows.

openchamberApp.note: The fleet build carries a 5-commit delta on top of upstream v2.5.2 whose objects are not published. harness/openchamber-patches records the delta, not a tree copy, and states the gap.
